title: Planet Suika
description:
Welcome to Planet Suika!Take your Suika stacking skills to a new planetary level in this Casual Puzzle Game! Combine smaller planets together to turn them into larger planets. Build your stack strategically, or you'll cross the Game Over line. 

Make sure to combine planets covered in star dust to double your points, use the meteor showers to rack up a high score! How long can you survive? 

The Bounciest Physics in Suika!Who knew planets could be so bouncy? Use the Plutos and Moons to take control of your stack and navigate space. Master the games Physics to combine the planets until you make a big Sun! 

Go Beyond the Sun!Flex your skills by merging two suns and creating a black hole that wipes out all other planets on the board. Score big, and get more space to pile up planets for even higher scores!
